title: Repeated-Syndrome Decoder
code: BT1872 [[66,13,3]]_3 parent with BT1878 single-error table

single_error_policy.persistent_same_syndrome_2_cycles: correct using BT1878 unique single-error table
single_error_policy.single_cycle_syndrome_only: flag transient; do not immediately correct unless hardware policy demands

dangerous_relation_policy.three_cycle_alternating_single_decoder_o: do not apply nearest-single correction; request another syndrome round or erasure/postselection

decision_table.SS0_or_0SS: correct if same nonzero syndrome persists two adjacent cycles

interpretation: The repeated decoder converts BT1878's single-shot table into a safe history decoder: it corrects persistent single-error syndromes and flags patterns compatible with distance-3 weight-3 relations instead of pretending to correct generic weight-2 errors.
boundary: History-rule decoder only. It is not a maximum-likelihood decoder or calibrated detector-time noise model.
